logp.method_description: Partition Coefficients Measurements (log Pow). Octanol/water partition coefficients (log Pow) of 1-3were investigated to assess the hydrophobicity/lipophilicity by following a reported method[9] at roomtemperature. Here, 1-octanol and milli-Q water were taken as the organic and aqueous phases,respectively. Initially, a specific concentration of complex was added in a mixture solvent having anequal volume of water (pre-saturated with 1-octanol) and 1-octanol (pre-saturated with water) with 3mL each and was shaken for 24 h followed by centrifugation at 4000 rpm for 10 min. Then both thephases are separated and individual concentrations of the Ru complex in organic as well as inaqueous phases were measured by UV-vis absorption spectra. The 1-octanol/water partitioncoefficients were calculated using the equation: log Pow = log (AO/AW), where AO and AW are theabsorbance of the complex in the 1-octanol and water phases, respectively.[9a]
